## FrontView REIT Achieves BBB- Investment Grade Rating from Fitch Ratings


November 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/268754373/files/doc_news/FrontView-REIT-Achieves-BBB--Investment-Grade-Rating-from-Fitch-Ratings-2026.pdf)


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


FrontView REIT, Inc. (NYSE: FVR) (the “Company”, “FrontView”, “we”, “our”, or “us”), today announced that Fitch Ratings (“Fitch”) has assigned the Company a BBB- investment-grade rating with a stable outlook.


“Achieving an investment-grade rating from Fitch represents a significant milestone for FrontView, particularly as the smallest publicly traded REIT by market capitalization to earn this distinction, just over two years after our IPO,” said Pierre Revol, President and Chief Financial Officer of FrontView REIT. “This rating reflects the quality of our underlying real estate, the strength and diversification of our portfolio, and the disciplined execution of our strategy. Our real estate-first approach, focused on owning high-quality properties in desirable locations, supports attractive cash flows and has delivered sector-leading rent recapture rates while providing meaningful downside protection. Importantly, this rating further strengthens our competitive position by lowering our cost of capital, expanding our access to institutional debt markets and enhancing our ability to pursue accretive growth opportunities.”


Fitch Rating Highlights:


- **Highly granular, diversified portfolio:** 327 properties across 36 states and 172 tenant concepts, averaging about $3.2 million per property, with roughly 79% located in the top 100 MSAs
- **Strong operating fundamentals** : 99.4% occupancy, a weighted-average lease term of about 7 years, favorable re-leasing outcomes and contractual rent escalators
- **Limited tenant concentration:** the largest tenant represents about 2.5% of annualized base rent (lowest in the sector)
- **Conservative balance sheet:** a fully unencumbered portfolio with no secured debt, leverage appropriate for the rating and strong near-term liquidity


**About FrontView REIT, Inc.**


FrontView is an internally managed net-lease real estate investment trust (“REIT”) focused on acquiring, owning, and managing properties with frontage that are leased to a diversified tenant base. Our real estate investment strategy is centered around highly visible properties in prominent retail corridors with strong underlying real estate fundamentals. We target properties along high-traffic roads that offer strong consumer visibility and adaptable building formats capable of supporting various businesses over time.


As of September 30, 2026, FrontView owned a diversified portfolio of 327 direct frontage properties across 36 U.S. states, leased primarily to service and necessity-based tenants across 16 industries, including medical and dental providers, quick-service and casual dining restaurants, financial institutions, cellular retailers, automotive-related, fitness, and general retail, along with several other diversified industries.
